validity_findings.finding: Orthogonality pooled over combined A+B+C violates frozen measurement_validity
validity_findings.detail: Spec measurement_validity #3 and decision_rule C4 require endpoint-stratified pooled Pearson r on non-304 samples from co-occurring conditions (Phase B). Producer computes r on COMBINED A+B+C (result.json validity_notes[4], run_experiment.py compute_orthogonality all_results = A+B+C, observations n=225). Phase B alone has behavioral constant 0.8 (all drift_active) so r is undefined (nan, ConstantInputWarning, std 1e-16); pooling A (0.8,1) + C (0, varying) manufactures variance and creates artificial negative correlation. Reported r=-0.5346 CI [-0.612,-0.466] TOST p_upper 3.99e-29 passes one-sided but fails two-sided equivalence and indicates non-orthogonality (magnitude 0.53 >>0.15).

validity_findings.finding: One-sided equivalence test insufficient for orthogonality claim
validity_findings.detail: Frozen C4 requires CI_upper <0.15 and TOST p_upper <0.05 at delta 0.15. This is one-sided H0 r>=0.15. Large negative correlation (-0.534) passes CI_upper (-0.466 <0.15) and p_upper ~4e-29 but two-sided test fails decisively (Fisher CI [-0.622,-0.434] outside [-0.15,0.15], p_lower ~1.0, |r| far exceeds delta, shared variance 28% vs allowed 2.25%). Validated ancestors (EXP-GRAPH-35389145821 r=0.002 CI_upper 0.092, EXP-PRODUCT-35445596342 r=-0.026 CI [-0.115,0.064]) are near-zero. Producer inherits PASS wording but measurement shows systematic anti-correlation induced by pooling artifact.

validity_findings.finding: Variance gate C3 computed on combined data not 8 co-occurring conditions
validity_findings.detail: Spec C3 requires >=2/3 endpoints with behavioral_std>0.05 and structural_std>0.05 in the 8 co-occurring conditions (Phase B). validity_findings.detail: Spec measurement_validity #7 and prereg 4.3 state structural signal is cardinality of (ETag, Cache-Control, X-Request-Id) + entropy, headers-only, body-hash excluded. claim_ceiling: Maximum justified: On localhost Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.14.0 HS256 + SQLite WAL mock at 127.0.0.1:18928 (TESTBED_SECRET testbed-hs256-shared-secret-exp-product-35697049382), the kernel freshness_check subprocess that GETs mechanism.freshness.probe_url with Bearer token and scores behavioral 0.8 on 401/403 (vs 0.0 on 200) detects expired/invalid token and permission_boundary drift with TP=1.0 (45/45, 15 per endpoint) at threshold 0.25 and tolerates 4 structural noise types with FP=0.0 (0/60 at N=5 per cell, not prereg N=20) with no regression on 3 existing kernel tests (which do not exercise freshness) and median latency ~1ms <<200ms on localhost. Orthogonality at delta 0.15 is NOT demonstrated per frozen spec: pooled r=-0.53 with CI entirely below -0.43 on combined A+B+C is anti-correlated (not equivalent within [-0.15,0.15]), and spec-required Phase B only is degenerate (behavioral constant). Parallel-channel (behavioral+structural) justification for kernel productization is not established vs behavioral-only/structural-only baselines (not measured). No inference to production OAuth/OIDC, CDN, DB sessions, browser RTT, or to PRODUCT_CORE; no LLM calls used as mandated. Replication at N=20 per cell with non-degenerate orthogonality design and missing baselines required before bounded PRODUCT_CORE advance.
